## What it is

Paperless-ngx turns paper and PDFs into a searchable archive: it OCRs scans, tags and files them, and serves them in a web UI ([paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx](https://github.com/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx)).

**Licence:** `GPL-3.0` (GitHub licence API; license-matrix row "Paperless-ngx"). Market class **L2**.

**Icon:** a neutral generated icon with initials; no upstream logo is shipped.

## Market listing

- Category and sub-tags (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1): files: documents. The sub-tags go into `metadata.tags` once the schema has it.
- Deployment class (TAXONOMY §2): **Market · community** until CI writes a passing scan (contract §9.4), then Market · verified if every check passes.

## How it runs here

- One `Deployment` (`Recreate`) with three containers: `webserver`, and native sidecars `db` (PostgreSQL 18) and `broker` (Valkey 9), the three services of upstream's `docker-compose.postgres.yml`.
- The database runs as a native sidecar in the same pod and listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so no other pod can reach it. For that reason PostgreSQL trusts local connections and there is no database password and no Secret (contract §11.2 forbids committed Secrets; §12.18 `spec.secrets` with generated values is not in the schema yet). When `spec.secrets` exists, a generated password can replace `trust`.
- `PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY` is required and has no default (configuration.md). An init container generates a random key once onto the data volume (mode 0600) and Paperless reads it through `PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY_FILE`.
- Rootless, as docs/setup.md "Rootless" describes: the webserver runs as UID 1000, PostgreSQL and Valkey as UID 999. No privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped. Rootless mode cannot install extra OCR languages (`PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGES`); the image includes English, German, Italian, Spanish and French.
- Volumes: `paperless-ngx-data` (20 GiB: `data/`, `media/`, `consume/`, `export/`) and `paperless-ngx-db` (5 GiB). Valkey's queue is in memory-backed scratch space.
- Probes: `GET /` (what the image HEALTHCHECK requests); startup allows 10 minutes for migrations.

## First run

Source: [docs.paperless-ngx.com](https://docs.paperless-ngx.com/setup/) "After installation".

1. Install Paperless-ngx from the Market and approve the action. It installs into `app-paperless-ngx`.
2. Forward the port and open http://localhost:8000:
   ```sh
   kubectl -n app-paperless-ngx port-forward svc/paperless-ngx 8000:8000
   ```
3. "When you first access the web interface, you will be prompted to create a superuser account." Do this right after install.
4. Upload documents in the web UI. To reach it from other devices under another address, set `PAPERLESS_URL` (configuration.md) in the Deployment.

## Not done yet

- Tika and Gotenberg (Office documents and e-mail) are not packaged.
- The consume folder is reachable only inside the volume; no network share is packaged.
- No HTTPS or LAN hostname: OneMind v0 has no ingress or certificates for apps, so the web UI is reached through a port-forward until the app proxy exists.
- `readOnlyRootFilesystem` is not set: it has not been tested against this image.
- Resource figures are OneMind choices where upstream gives none; they are checked against real use when the CI smoke test (contract §9.4 check 9) runs.
- `metadata.tier` stays `community` until `sdk/tools/app-gate` in CI writes a passing `scan.json`. `spec.updates.automerge` is `none` until `renovate.json` lists the app.

## Why this app is blocked

The CI app gate (`sdk/tools/app-gate`, contract §9.4) computed tier **blocked** for this app on 2026-11-12 (ci-apps run 43212765046, job `gate (paperless-ngx)`). The gateway lists a blocked app in the Market but refuses to install it (§10.3, §11.1). The app is kept, not hidden, and the gate was not weakened. Reasons from that run:

- Vulnerability: `docker.io/library/postgres:18.6-trixie`: CRITICAL CVE-2025-68121 in the Go `stdlib` v1.24.6, fixed in 1.24.13, 1.25.7 or 1.26.0-rc.3.
- Secret finding (Trivy): the same postgres image has `private-key` (HIGH) in `/etc/ssl/private/ssl-cert-snakeoil.key` (Debian's ssl-cert package).
- Passed: licence GPL-3.0, ClamAV (0 infected), smoke test (GET / returned 302). The paperless-ngx 3.4.2 image itself has no CRITICAL with a fix (CRITICALs without a fix are recorded only: libmariadb3 CVE-2026-44172 and CVE-2026-49261, libxml2 CVE-2026-6653).

To unblock: move the pins to upstream releases that fix these findings (tags that exist, checked with `crane`), then rerun `sdk/tools/app-gate` (the daily `apps-rescan` workflow does this too). Nothing is bumped to an unverified tag.
